objective: Test a verified cross-tool document serialization sequence as selective knowledge adaptation, improving normal completion and actual required artifact quality.

mechanism.cause: Changed bulk tool cannot produce requested custom content. The verified alternative writer wraps content in page frontmatter; a complete Markdown sequence can be persisted at index0 in a fresh single-cover project, but in-memory records remain unsplit. Immediate apply_theme loses later pages; load_slidev first splits them, making theme application preserve the sequence. Leading whole-document frontmatter creates an extra empty page.
mechanism.intervention: Base Selective Patch plus four localized rules: changed create_bulk_slides and directly dependent set_page, load_slidev, apply_theme. Give the exact small synthetic Markdown format and ordering, preserving capability limits. Metadata/routing unchanged. No budget instructions, paper facts, task outline, target slide count, answer or scoring advice.
mechanism.inputs: Only stage metadata plus reviewed independent synthetic serialization observations. No question/answer/score/agent trace enters updater.
mechanism.changed_basis: Every added rule cites the actual create_bulk_slides metadata change. Inherited writer/loader/theme constraints are relevant because changed bulk cannot satisfy custom content; do not label those constraints newly introduced drift.
mechanism.source_evidence: 38 preregistered local calls across two stages, including24 content-loss counterexamples and14 successful reordered calls; files, source hashes and three real rendered pages archived at e05b7e5.
mechanism.scope: Fresh one-cover projects only, not clearing populated decks or guaranteeing arbitrary long/HTML content. Task457 exposed subset and task235 exactK0; original artifact_contract rejected, not rerun.
mechanism.uncertainty: A concrete serialization example may reduce tool-format uncertainty and permit completion, but cannot guarantee the model avoids reasoning truncation. Any such claim requires fresh comparison.

validation_schedule.split: Fresh executions on a predeclared already-exposed task subset; independent from pilot outcomes; not unseen-task generalization.
validation_schedule.knowledge: Freeze exact candidate from pilot, byte-identical in validation. No tuning, selection or low-score reruns.
validation_schedule.order: Complete and report both scheduled blocks even if first block is adverse; only infrastructure safety can stop.

properties.required: A readable persisted slide-deck artifact exists and contains the actual presentation. Tool-return templates or final prose alone do not count. No unreplaced boilerplate, accidental repeated blocks or missing substantive sections; deck length/density and sequence plausibly support15minutes. No mandatory slide count or speaker-note requirement.

Each of the three supplied2023 papers is identified and its main contribution accurately represented from its source. PaLM-E: continuous multimodal inputs into a language model for embodied reasoning/planning and transfer;RT-2: co-finetuned vision-language-action model with actions as tokens and transferred web knowledge;Voyager: Minecraft lifelong exploration with automatic curriculum, executable skill library and iterative environment-feedback prompting. Wording may differ; no requirement to state optional metrics. Major factual/numerical claims must be correct.

Actual slides meaningfully compare the approaches on shared dimensions and conclude with grounded future directions. Distinguish the robotic sensor/language-planning, robot action-policy and code-agent/game settings; proposals must not be presented as demonstrated results.

Unaltered deck renders in the frozen common runtime. Substantive slides use a consistent dark design with legible hierarchy and contrast, without clipping/overlap/dense text that prevents presenting. Inspect every page and progressive reveals where relevant. Theme flags alone do not pass; unavailable rendering is unknown.
Final delivery identifies the created artifact accurately and does not falsely claim checks, exports, paper findings or completeness contradicted by actual stored slides and tool evidence.

quality_cases.review: Blind method and TF/PE before reviewing current outputs, persisted files and rendered pages against supplied PDF sources. Preserve errors/unknowns. Read only needed source passages. Do not modify output to pass. Same coordinator review, not an independent human; method may be inferable from behavior.

properties.required: Three requested chart types returned successfully with source values, ordering, provinces/categories and monetary units preserved.
Any substantive final claim about these data matches the inputs; source totals if stated are exact.

quality_cases.review: Frozen question and actual chart payloads; rendering remains unknown for both arms and is not added as a requirement.

evaluation.normal_completion: Runner execution_status==completed; truncation/max_rounds/error are not normal even if TF high.
evaluation.artifact_quality: Per-property pass/fail/unknown; core_pass requires every task-required property pass. Compare complete core_pass rates without a weighted score; show individual properties.
evaluation.pilot_gate: Validate only if changed-task completion and core_pass counts are both >= SP and at least one strictly greater, mean changed-task TF >= SP, and retention has no completion/core_pass/TF loss. Else reject this candidate without rerunning it until it wins.
evaluation.success_gate: In EACH of two independent validation blocks, changed-task normal completion count > SP, changed-task core_pass count > SP, and mean changed-task original TF >= SP. Retention completion/core_pass counts and mean TF >= SP in each block. Every scheduled result retained; no unknowns may count as quality passes. No requirement to win every cell or baseline.
evaluation.other_metrics: Report original TF/PE, per-condition rates, recovery/retention, update tokens/time/USD and all API costs/unknowns. ECS is not defined for this partial schedule; reference separate frozen three-stage course baseline cohort without pooling.
evaluation.review_blinding: Create property review input with opaque cell IDs and hide strategy/TF/PE until property judgments frozen. Same rubric in pilot and validation. Five judges are ratings, not executions.
evaluation.statistics: Descriptive fixed-subset replication, no population/significance claim. Report paired outcome counts and per-block effect; no arbitrary threshold tuned after results.
evaluation.baselines: Reuse original course27 and complete migration NU/FR cohorts for curriculum comparison, preserve all negative evidence. Do not substitute those scores as concurrent pilot controls.
